name: Hövelhof (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically green and white, charged in the upper third with the municipal arms of Hövelhof (a cross and a tree on white and green).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Detmold of 16 September 1971 the municipality of Hövelhof was granted the right to bear a banner, described as green and white striped lengthwise with the municipal arms in the upper third.
